buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic The buyer organization is an institution eligible for concessional rates of GST as notified by the Government of India. The services for which bids have been invited fall under classification of GST concession and the conditions for eligibility of concession are met by the institution. A certificate to this effect will be issued by Buyer to the Seller after award of the Contract. Sellers are requested to submit their bids after accounting for the Concessional rate of GST. Applicable Concessional rate of GST : 10 % Notification No.and date : dated 28/06/2017 4. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. RIGHT TO ACCEPT, REJECT OR CANCEL THE BID The Competent Authority, PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya OF Bhandara, reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids, wholly or partially, and to annul or cancel the bidding process at any stage prior to award o f contract, in accordance with applicable GeM provisions and Government procurement rules, without ther eby incurring any liability to the affected bidder(s). Such decision shall be supported by appropriate reasons recorded on file. The Vidyalaya also reserves the right to postpone, modify or withdraw the tender, or amend any terms and conditions through a corrigendum on the GeM portal, wherever considered necessary in the public interest or due to administrative or technical reasons. No bidder shall have any claim for compensation, loss of profit or damages on account of such cancellation

or modification. After award of contract, cancellation or termination shall be governed by the termination provisions of the contract and applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions. 2. TERMINATION OF CONTRACT The Principal, PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya OF Bhandara, reserves the right to terminate the contract, wholl y or partially, by giving 30 days' written notice, in the administrative interest of the Vidyalaya or due to an y other valid reason, in accordance with the contract conditions. The contract may also be terminated for breach of contractual obligations, persistent unsatisfactory perfor mance, non-payment of wages, non-deposit of statutory contributions, submission of false documents, una uthorized absence of deployed personnel, or violation of applicable laws and GeM conditions. In cases of serious misconduct, fraud, safety violations or other grave contractual breaches, the contract may be terminated in accordance with the applicable contractual provisions, after following the required pr ocedure. Upon termination, the service provider shall be entitled only to payment for satisfactory services actually r endered up to the effective date of termination, subject to verification and adjustment of recoveries, penal ties and other lawful dues. . 9. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 10. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 11. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 12. Service & Support The Service Provider is required to have at least 30 % of the required manpower on service provider’s payroll for at least one year. Necessary documents relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid.
